name: 46803 · Fort Wayne, IN
findings: ZIP 46803 (Fort Wayne) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (69% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46803 (Fort Wayne) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46803 (Fort Wayne) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
